title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: The \(64\) whole numbers from \(1\) through \(64\) are written, one per square, on a checkerboard (an \(8\) by \(8\) array of \(64\) squares). The first \(8\) numbers are written in order across the first row, the next \(8\) across the second row, and so on. After all \(64\) numbers are written, the sum of the numbers in the four corners will be

solutions.text:
The first row is \(1, 2, \ldots, 8\) and the last row is \(57, 58, \ldots, 64.\) The four corners are \(1,\) \(8,\) \(57,\) and \(64.\)

Their sum is \(1 + 8 + 57 + 64 = 130.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: The first row holds \(1\) through \(8;\) the last row holds \(57\) through \(64\)
The four corners are the first and last numbers of the top row and of the bottom row
